texts.布兹在触发援护时，对援护过程中的碰撞的目标造成昏迷效果，持续2秒，并对援护目标添: When Buzz triggers Emergency Assist, he inflicts Stun on targets collided with during the assist for 2 sec, grants [Energy Shield] to the assisted target, and restores 60 Rage to himself. Cooldown: 15 sec
texts.布兹搭载的紧急维修模块会在布兹受到致命伤害时，将生命值回复至100%,一场战斗仅: Buzz's Emergency Repair module restores his HP to 100% when he takes fatal DMG; triggers only once per battle.
Every 6 sec, Buzz applies a Shield to the ally with the lowest current HP; Shield value = 5% of Buzz's current HP + 540.0% Spell Power. Also, every 5 sec, inflicts Taunt on enemy Mystic Front or 狙魔 heroes on the field, making their Normal Attacks target himself.
texts.布拉欣多单次受到超过最大生命值10%的伤害时，有70%的几率触发相位转移，将本次: When Brahindor takes a single instance of DMG exceeding 10% of his Max HP, there is a 70% chance to trigger Blink, reducing that DMG to 10% of Max HP; on trigger, restores HP equal to 37.5% Spell Power to all allies (the amount is additionally affected by Mental Mastery).
texts.布拉欣多对奥术魔法的研究使奥术灌注的持续时间延长5秒，并恢复100点怒气，并额外: Brahindor's study of arcane magic extends the duration of Arcane Infusion by 5 sec, restores 100 Rage, and adds one extra target
texts.当有敌人出现在审判使者8米范围内时，审判使者会快速向敌人冲去。靠近目标后，审判使: When an enemy appears within 8 m of Apostle of Judgment, Apostle of Judgment quickly rushes toward it. After reaching the target, Apostle of Judgment gains a heavy-strike Normal Attack effect (Normal Attack DMG increased by 300%) and Attack Speed increased by 30%+per point of Spell Mastery*0.5% (never exceeding 60%); these effects last 2 sec. If Mirages exist, the Mirages also use the [Steel Breaker] skill.

Once [Alluring Phantom] is unlocked, inflicts Charmed Mark on enemies hit.
texts.当队伍中有人对敌方施加昏迷效果时，朝目标释放5枚飞剑，每一枚飞剑都会造成3000: Whenever a team member inflicts Stun on an enemy, launches 5 flying swords at the target, each dealing 3000% Physical Power as Holy DMG. (This effect has a 0.5 sec trigger interval)

Trigger chance: 30%. While holding charges, consumes 1 charge every 2 sec to strike 1 random enemy with lightning, dealing 10000% Spell Power as Lightning DMG
texts.当队友被暴击或濒死时迷迭妖精会立刻对其进行治疗治疗量等于目标最大生命值的12%(: When an ally is critically hit or near death, Salvia Fairy immediately heals them for 12% of the target's Max HP (minimum interval: 1 sec)

texts.拉拉克与生俱来的火焰亲和能力使她技能暴击率提升1%*法术精通，每次施放火球时，都: Lara's innate Fire affinity increases her Skill Crit% by 1%*Spell Mastery. texts.指定一个友方黑卫，使其在释放必杀技之后，有一定几率再次释放(千霄月守的感知属性越: Designates one allied Blackguard; after casting an Ultimate Skill, it has a certain chance to cast it again (the higher 千霄月守's Perception, the higher the trigger chance, and the repeated Ultimate Skill costs no Rage). This effect has a 6 sec trigger interval. (Ultimate Skills of some Blackguards with long-lasting effects, such as Kashinfuu and Brittany, cannot be affected by this skill.)
texts.挥动巨斧对前方敌人造成1200%法术强度的火焰伤害。: Swings a great axe, dealing 1200% Spell Power as Fire DMG to enemies in front.
texts.提高100%几率额外召唤1个小史莱姆。: Increases the chance to summon 1 extra baby slime by 100%.

texts.斯卡莉特每次闪烁后一段时间内受到伤害降低20%，持续5秒: After each teleport, Scarlett takes 20% less DMG for a while, lasting 5 sec

texts.斯卡莉特闪烁至场上距离自己最远的敌方目标身后，挥动镰刀对当前敌方目标造成400%: Scarlett teleports behind the enemy target farthest from her on the field and swings her scythe, dealing 400% Spell Power as Frost DMG to the current enemy target
texts.无法逃离，无法躲避，这就是永生的代价。奥瑞安重生时，对周围2.5米范围内的敌方单: No escape, no evasion: this is the price of immortality. When Orion is reborn, he deals 450% Physical Power as Physical DMG to enemy units within 2.5 m around him and applies [永生诅咒] to targets hit.
texts.普攻击中敌人时，有100%几率使目标感电。: When a Normal Attack hits an enemy, there is a 100% chance to inflict Electrocution on the target.
texts.普攻击中敌人时，有25%几率使目标目盲。目盲:降低75%普攻命中几率。: When a Normal Attack hits an enemy, there is a 25% chance to inflict Blind on the target. Blind: reduces Normal Attack Accuracy by 75%.
texts.普攻命中时，有50%%几率对目标施加【中毒】效果，持续10秒。: On Normal Attack hit, there is a 50% chance to inflict [Poisoning] on the target for 10 sec.
texts.普攻时有25%的几率会额外执行一次。: Normal Attacks have a 25% chance to be performed once more.
texts.普通攻击的目标数量+3，造成【中毒】的几率增加50%。: Normal Attack target count +3; chance to inflict [Poisoning] increased by 50%.
texts.普通攻击闪避几率提升15%: Dodge (Attack) chance against Normal Attacks increased by 15%
texts.暂停场上的时间，暂停结束时，使绑定队友的生命值、护盾值、怒气值、技能冷却等属性回: Pauses time on the field. When the pause ends, reverts the bound ally's HP, Shield value, Rage, Skill Cooldown and other attributes to their state at the start of battle (this also works when the bound ally is dead; if at the start of battle the team has only one Blackguard, Blossom Amour, this skill is not cast), and deals 10000% Physical Power as Holy DMG to all enemies on the field. Blossom Amour cannot restore Rage by any other means and is unaffected by Rage reduction effects; it can only restore Rage through its own skills.

texts.朝前方敌人发射大量带有毒药的弩箭,对每个触碰到的敌人造成31.3%物理强度的物理: Fires a large number of poison-tipped crossbow bolts at enemies in front, dealing 31.3% Physical Power as Physical DMG to each enemy touched, and each bolt hit applies [Poisoning] to the target for 10 sec. [Poisoning]: deals 2.5% Physical Power as Physical DMG per second, stacks up to 100 times, each stack increases Poisoning DMG by 1%.
texts.朝前方释放一道光束，每道光束对触碰到的敌人造成2500％法术强度的闪电伤害: Fires one beam forward; each beam deals 2500% Spell Power as Lightning DMG to enemies it touches
texts.朝前方释放落雷，对落雷范围内的敌人造成900%法术强度的闪电伤害: Calls down a lightning strike ahead, dealing 900% Spell Power as Lightning DMG to enemies within the strike area

texts.朝目标方向突进6米,对路径上的敌人造成160%物理强度的闪电伤害，击中感电敌人时: Dashes 6 m toward the target, dealing 160% Physical Power as Lightning DMG to enemies in the path; when hitting an enemy with Electrocution, inflicts Stun for 1 sec. texts.柯杨娜对离自己最近的三个目标射出三支箭，分别对每个目标造成60%物理强度的闪电伤: 柯杨娜 shoots three arrows at the three targets nearest to her, dealing 60% Physical Power as Lightning DMG to each target
texts.柯杨娜日益精进的技术使柯杨娜的暴击几率增加15%，暴击伤害增加50%。: 柯杨娜's ever-improving skill increases 柯杨娜's Crit Chance by 15% and Crit Dmg by 50%.
